title: VMamba2: 2D Selective State-Space Scanning for Parameter-Efficient and Reproducible Urban Temperature Downscaling
description: Official PyTorch implementation of VMamba2, a 2D selective state-space bottleneck for U-Net architectures applied to urban temperature downscaling. The model downscales ERA5-Land (~9 km) air temperature to UrbClim targets (100 m) over the Barcelona metropolitan area. Trained across five independent seeds (n=5) with two temporal windows (T=6 and T=12 hours) and benchmarked against ConvLSTM, U-Net, and 1D Mamba baselines. Includes full training and evaluation pipeline, figure generation scripts, and result CSVs.
